title: Cobblestone floor
doc: The ground set: Poly Haven's cobblestone_floor_04 at 2K, colour, normal, roughness, ambient occlusion and a 16-bit height; T2's proof set, the first textured document.

provenance.source: Poly Haven, https://polyhaven.com/a/cobblestone_floor_04 (CC0 1.0), fetched 2026-10-04 at 2K by tools/fetch_polyhaven.py; the set's LICENSE.md names the authors
provenance.note: base_color, specular_roughness, geometry_normal, ambient_occlusion, height: each binds the set's map of that name; base_color and specular_roughness carry the factor 1.0 because legacy v2 multiplies the sample by the factor; the family's metalness 0 stands (the set has no metalness map)
